title: Position-Swapped LLM Judge with Human Agreement
hints: Two judge calls per pair, in order: candidate in slot 1 first, then baseline in slot 1. Build both prompts from the same TEMPLATE.
Map each raw answer back to a model before comparing. In the swapped call, '1' means the baseline won.
Disagreeing orders become a tie, and they stay in every denominator. Position bias is the same slot winning both times.
Cohen's kappa = (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e), with p_e the sum over labels of judge share times human share, computed only on human-labeled pairs.
